'''Blue Eight''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] fighter [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Serving as a member of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], the Rebel stationed onboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] until being [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the months before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Blue Eight was honored at a funeral service along with fellow pilots [[Smithy]], [[Roanda]], [[Voxx]] and [[Waudok]].
